dds_talion_10.m: Oh, it's good that you said that.

dds_talion_12.m: Then I have to slightly modify the chant so that it stays fresh and will still work after your long journey.

dds_talion_30.m: There. I hope Borvis knows what he is doing.
r: Thank you. And I need to ask you something.
Where can I receive blessings of Shadow Sleepiness, Fatigue and Life Drain?

dds_talion_40.m: How about a word of thanks first?

dds_talion_42.m: Oh times, oh customs. These ill-behaved children these days...

dds_talion_44.m: Well, you see - was that really so difficult?

dds_talion_50.m: Just tell me what you need to know.
r: Where can I receive blessings of Shadow Sleepiness, Fatigue and Life Drain?

dds_talion_60.m: Why do you need all those? I hope you are not helping the Shadow's enemies get through a Shadow shield!

r: Borvis wants my help in breaking a Shadow shield in the south of Stoutford. He says someone is misusing Shadow powers behind the Shield.

dds_talion_70.m: Sending a kid to do a priest's job! Isn't Borvis strong enough?

dds_talion_72.m: Very well. Go to my friend Jolnor for Shadow Sleepiness. Rest you get even in spite of bad dreams - but not permanently, and potion effects don't help.
r: Right. I got that ... I think.

dds_talion_82.m: It'll just cost you another 300 gold pieces.
r: If that's all - here you go.
I don't have that much with me. I'll be back.

loneford_ill_c_5.m: There's something else also. I talked to that drunk, Landa, in the tavern earlier today. He said he saw something but didn't dare tell me what it was.
r: Thank you, I will go talk to him.
Great, another drunk that I have to talk to.
Do you know anything about the illness here in Loneford?
Do you have anything to trade?
I need some help finding out who is responsible for casting a Shadow spell that causes a person to become noticeable.
Sorry, we were interrupted. You were just talking about the Striking Spectacle Shadow spell.
Here I've brought you the things that you require for the dispelling.
Do you know the whereabouts of Sly Seraphina?
I've brought you the things you had required for dispelling.
Borvis said you could provide me with some information.
The blessing has worn off too early. Could you give it again?

talion_1.m: The people of Loneford are very keen on following the will of Feygard, whatever it may be.

talion_2.m: Normally, this would not be a problem. But Lord Geomyr seems to have something against the Shadow. He will do almost anything to oppose all actions that in some way extend the reach of the Shadow.

talion_3.m: Because of this, the people of Loneford are now actively abolishing the thought of the Shadow guiding them through their lives.

talion_4.m: People around here would rather follow the law of Feygard than follow the old ways.

talion_5.m: My feeling is that this illness is caused by the Shadow, as punishment to all of us here in Loneford.

talion_bless_1.m: I am able to bless you with either the Shadow's strength, regeneration, accuracy, or even the blessing of the Shadow guardian.
r: I'm interested in the blessing of Shadow strength.
I'm interested in the blessing of Shadow regeneration.
I'm interested in the blessing of Shadow accuracy.
I'm interested in the Shadow guardian blessing.

talion_bless_2.m: There. I hope you will find it useful on your travels.
r: How about some of those other blessings?

talion_bless_acc_1.m: The blessing of Shadow accuracy grants you a keen sense of where best to strike your opponent, thus increasing the chance of a successful hit while fighting. I can give you the blessing for 250 gold.
r: OK, I'll take it for 250 gold.
Never mind, let's go back to those other blessings.

talion_bless_guard_1.m: Ah yes, the blessing of the Shadow guardian. The Shadow protects you in dark places, and keeps you safe where others might not see. I can give you the blessing for 400 gold.
r: OK, I'll take it for 400 gold.
Never mind, let's go back to those other blessings.

talion_bless_heal_1.m: The blessing of Shadow regeneration will slowly heal you back if you get hurt. I can give you the blessing for 250 gold.
r: OK, I'll take it for 250 gold.
Never mind, let's go back to those other blessings.

talion_bless_str_1.m: The blessing of Shadow strength grants you more strength while attacking, thus increasing the amount of damage you do on each hit. I can give you the blessing for 300 gold.
r: OK, I'll take it for 300 gold.
Never mind, let's go back to those other blessings.
OK, I'll take it for 300 gold. I need it for Borvis to work an enchantment. He is waiting far to the south.

talion_bone_1.m: Oh, good. Please, give them to me.
r: On second thought, I'll be right back.

talion_cure_1.m: That's all I need to cure you. Good work.

talion_cure_2.m: Now, let's get this cure started. I just need to grind this ... and mix those ... and...

talion_cure_4.m: [Talion mixes the ground up ingredients together in the vial you brought, with some leaves and berries that he kept with him]

talion_cure_5.m: [He gives the potion a thorough shake for quite a while]

talion_cure_6.m: There. Drink this. This should do it.

talion_cure_7.m: [The potion smells rancid, but you manage to drink it all down. The pain from the stomach decreases, and you feel one of the rotworms crawling up into your mouth. You quickly spit the worm out into the now empty vial.]

talion_cured_1.m: Ah, that seems to have worked. Frankly, I was a little worried that it might not have worked, but seeing you spit out that worm really confirms it. Ha ha.
r: Yuck! Those things were inside of me?

talion_cured_10.m: Yes. Well ... for a fee of course.

talion_cured_3.m: That one worm you spit out, you should make sure you hold on to that. It might be valuable in the future.
r: OK, I will hold on to it.
I think I had better put it under my boot.

talion_cured_4.m: Well, you never know. Some people really like ... exotic things.

talion_cured_7.m: Now, I know you must have gone through a lot to get infected with these things. You seem like the experienced type.

talion_cured_8.m: Tell you what, I don't normally offer this to anyone, but you seem like you could use the help.

talion_cured_9.m: Seeing as you managed to pull through all of this, I would be willing to offer you the help of giving you blessings of the Shadow if you want.

talion_demon_1.m: Just to be sure, you did kill whatever creature that infected you with this, right?
r: No, I have not killed it yet.

talion_demon_2.m: Good. Then I am able to help you.

talion_demon_3.m: Then you better go take care of that first!
r: OK, I will be back once the lich is defeated.

talion_gather_r.m: No need, you already brought me that before. But thank you anyway.

talion_hair_1.m: Oh, good. Please, give them to me.
r: On second thought, I'll be right back.

talion_infect_1.m: Oh my, what has happened to you? You don't look too well.
r: I was infected with something by a lich of Kazaul.
A man called Ulirfendor told me he thought I might be infected with Kazaul rotworms.
I was told to find you, and that you might be able to help me.

talion_infect_10.m: No, unfortunately not. Not with this few supplies I'm sorry.
r: Fine. What would you like me to do?
Bah! Then you are useless to me. Guess you should have prepared better before then.

talion_infect_11.m: For this particular cure to work, I would need help with gathering four items.

talion_infect_12.m: Or ... well ... actually, nine items in total, but four different types. Eh ... well, you get the idea.

talion_infect_13.m: Anyway, what you need to bring me is, first and foremost, some more fresh bones. Five bones will do I think. Make sure they are fresh. Any old skeleton will do, but I'd rather take some fresh bones of some nasty animal.

talion_infect_14.m: Secondly, I will need some animal fur to go with that. Two pieces of animal hair will surely do. I'm sure any old animal fur from the wilderness outside town will do.

talion_infect_15.m: Third, I will need a gland of poison from a creature called the irdegh.

talion_infect_16.m: Now, I have not seen an irdegh myself, but I hear they are particularly nasty creatures. Venomous like nothing I've heard of.
r: OK, one irdegh poison gland. Where can I find one?

talion_infect_17.m: Some people have talked about seeing some of them far to the east, across the bridges.

talion_infect_18.m: Lastly, I would need a clean empty vial to make the potion in. I hear that the potion-maker in Fallhaven has the best vials available.

talion_infect_19.m: Bring me these things and I will be able to help you with your ... condition.
r: Very well, I will be back shortly.

talion_infect_2.m: Ah, my old friend Ulirfendor. It's good to hear that he is still alive. Wait! What was that? Rotworms you say, eh?

talion_infect_3.m: Nasty things, they are. I have seen people going mad from the stomach pains, and I have seen people being eaten alive from the inside.
r: Are you able to help me?
It's not that bad. I have had worse.

talion_infect_30.m: You return. Have you gathered those things that I asked for?
r: What was I supposed to collect again?
I brought five bones for you.
I brought two pieces of animal hair for you.
I brought an irdegh poison gland for you.
I brought an empty vial for you.
Do you know anything about the illness here in Loneford?
Do you have anything to trade?

talion_infect_31.m: There are still some more of those items that I need.
r: What was I supposed to collect again?
I brought five bones for you.
I brought two pieces of animal hair for you.
I brought an irdegh poison gland for you.
I brought an empty vial for you.

talion_infect_4.m: It's good that you came to see me. I might be able to help you.

talion_infect_5.m: A lich of Kazaul eh? Then I am sure that whatever ails you are those cursed rotworms.

talion_infect_6.m: However, there is a slight problem. You see, normally my supply of potions and ingredients would be fully stocked. However with this trouble that we have here in Loneford, my supplies are lower than they have ever been before.

talion_infect_7.m: I am not even able to go out and gather new supplies, what with the illness and all.
r: Is there anything I can do to help?
Bah! Then you are useless to me. Guess you should have prepared better before then.

talion_infect_8.m: You know what, maybe you can go out and gather some items for me. With your condition, it is important that we hurry as much as we can.
r: What would you like me to do?
Argh! The pains are getting worse! Isn't there anything you can do?

talion_infect_9.m: Yes, I guess I should have.

talion_irdegh_1.m: Oh, good. Please, give it to me.
r: On second thought, I'll be right back.

talion_vial_1.m: Oh, good. Please, give it to me.
r: Here you go, one small empty vial.
Here you go, one empty vial.
On second thought, I'll be right back.

tt_talion_10.m: Oh, that lovely spell! The Striking Spectacle Shadow spell!

tt_talion_100.m: Behold - Luthor's ring! And this much gold! I didn't expect that you would manage this so soon.

tt_talion_110.m: [muttering] With all that gold and rings I could start a new and wealthy life in Nor City. Hmm ...
r: You know that I can hear you?

tt_talion_112.m: Eh, well. Now it's time to keep my promise and dispell your friends.

tt_talion_12.m: One of my specials! I just had an opportunity to use it again recently. It went great!
r: Why did you do that? People can get hurt!

tt_talion_130.m: Done. Go back to your friends, everything is as it was before.

tt_talion_20.m: Nonsense! How can it hurt to be more noticeable? It makes one stand out more, makes one more popular.
r: Not if you want to be a thief or similar.

tt_talion_30.m: Why would these so-called thieves approach you?
r: I'm a kid. No one notices me ...
The rings. I need them back of course.

tt_talion_310.m: Oh no, you don't. And it's not possible.

tt_talion_320.m: I said you don't need the rings. Also it's not possible ...
r: OK, it was just a question. Bye.

tt_talion_330.m: [Hasty] Now here is Luthor's ring. It is the only one that was powerfull enough to survive the spell. The others are broken.

tt_talion_40.m: That's debatable in your case, but I see the point.
r: Thanks! So, why did you do it?

tt_talion_50.m: Because of the gold! Why else?

tt_talion_52.m: Of course I use it for the church ...
r: Well, what will it take to remove the spell?

tt_talion_60.m: Around {50000} gold, of which a large portion will go back to the mysterious Lady Dameni, who had me do the spell. I would need to pacify her, otherwise her toughs will kill me.
r: {50000} gold! I hope the guild can reimburse me!

tt_talion_62.m: I also need a few more items ...

tt_talion_64.m: Indeed? We'll see. I need the following things:

tt_talion_70.m: Oh, just a few little things, easy to get.

tt_talion_72.m: Villain's ring, Troublemaker's ring, Ring of backstabbing, Tears of the Shadow potion. And most important, Luthor's ring. Together with {50000} gold.
r: You don't ask for much! Where do I find all that?
I don't have Troublemaker's ring yet.
I don't have the Ring of backstabbing yet.
I don't have the Villain's ring yet.
I don't have the Tears of the Shadow yet.
I don't have Luthor's ring yet.
I don't have the {50000} gold yet.
I have everthing other than Luthor's ring
Here's all you have asked for.

tt_talion_74.m: Well, then go and find it.

tt_talion_75.m: By the way, don't come to me with polished rings. The counterspell works with the unmeddled ones only. Hurry now!

r: Now I am going to find Luthor's ring.

tt_talion_80.m: Check with your thief friends, they should know. All these rings form part of your thievery business.

tt_talion_82.m: Yes, this ring might be a little harder to find. I trust in you.
r: Don't you have any idea where it could be?

tt_talion_86.m: I said no. Go now, child.

tt_talion_90.m: I don't know anybody with that name. Sorry.

tt_talion_92.m: Did you find the things I asked? Especially Luthor's Ring?
r: That is hard to get. No one knows where it is.

tt_talion_94.m: Good thieves don't have to search for the things they want. They know where they are.
r: Can't you cast the counterspell without the ring?

tt_talion_98.m: Find it or your friends may have to retire or go into another honest business. He he!

maggots.10: Deep inside a cavern, I encountered a lich of Kazaul. Somehow the lich managed to infect me with things that crawl around in my stomach! I must find some way to get rid of these things inside of me. I should go talk to Ulirfendor, or seek help in one of the chapels.
maggots.20: Ulirfendor tells me that he read something long ago about rotworms that feed upon living tissue. They can have what he called 'unusual' effects on whoever carries them, and their eggs can slowly kill a person from the inside. I should seek help immediately, before it is too late.
maggots.21: Ulirfendor says that one of the priests of the Shadow should be able help me. I should go visit Talion at the chapel in Loneford at once.
maggots.30: Talion in Loneford told me that in order to be cured of my affliction, I will need to bring four parts to him. The parts that I will need are five bones, two pieces of animal hair, one irdegh poison gland and one empty vial. Bones and fur can probably be found on some animal in the wilderness, and the poison gland can be found on one of the irdeghs that have been spotted to the east.
maggots.40: I have brought the five bones to Talion.
maggots.41: I have brought the two pieces of animal hair to Talion.
maggots.42: I have brought one irdegh poison gland to Talion.
maggots.43: I have brought an empty vial to Talion.
maggots.45: I have now brought all pieces that Talion needs in order to cure me of these things.
maggots.50: Talion has cured me of the Kazaul rotworms. I managed to get one of the rotworms into an empty vial, and Talion told me that it would be very valuable. I cannot imagine for what.
maggots.51: Because of my former affliction, Talion has agreed to help me by placing blessings of the Shadow upon me whenever I wish, for a fee.

troubling_times.10: I went to the Thieves' Guild in Fallhaven looking for things to do.
troubling_times.20: Since I had helped Defy, Umar and Nanath threw me out. I cannot enter the basement again.
troubling_times.30: Since I had looted the Thieves' Guild vault after killing Defy, Umar and Nanath threw me out. I cannot enter the basement again.
troubling_times.40: I met Nanath, who's scared and upset, because someone put a spell on all members of the Thieves' Guild. This spell made all thieves noticeable. He asked me if I could help dispel the spell.
troubling_times.50: Nanath told me to find the Shadow priest who had cast the spell on the Guild.
troubling_times.60: I set out interviewing Shadow priests to find who had cast the spell.
troubling_times.70: Talion, Shadow priest of Loneford, had cast the Striking Spectacle Shadow spell on the Guild, on payment from Dameni, a mysterious lady leading a band of toughs
troubling_times.80: Talion could dispel the spell, using a few items - Villain's ring, Troublemaker's ring, ring of backstabbing, Tears of the Shadow potion, Luthor's ring.  He also wanted 50000 gold.
troubling_times.82: I have informed Nanath about the Striking Spectacle Shadow spell and Talion's demands.
troubling_times.90: Nanath told me Thieves' Guild would give me the 50000 gold back when I have got the spell dispelled.
troubling_times.95: Nanath asked if I had already found Luthor's ring.
troubling_times.100: I went back to Nanath as I couldn't find Luthor's ring anywhere.
troubling_times.105: He told me to seek out Fanamor's friend Sly Seraphina near the Sutdover bridge.
troubling_times.110: Seraphina didn't believe me. She told me to go away.
troubling_times.115: Nanath sent me to Umar. He should make sure Sly carries out the order.
troubling_times.120: Umar told me one of his secret passwords to convince Seraphina.
troubling_times.130: Sly Seraphina said that Luthor's ring was to be found in the cave which Crackshot tried to open. The door was sealed by Umar and Seraphina to prevent monsters in that cave from devastating Dhayavar. The sealing was done by using Luthor's items. She and Umar decided to separate them, and keep them separate.
troubling_times.140: Seraphina felt that the danger was too high to open that door. So she disappeared.
troubling_times.150: I had to find Sly Seraphina again.
troubling_times.160: Nanath told me to look for her in her usual hiding places: Near one of the towns Sullengard, Stoutford, Vilegard, Prim, Loneford, or Brimhaven.
troubling_times.170: Talion said that without the items he asked for he couldn't help. I had to find Seraphina.
troubling_times.180: After beating the tough guys protecting Seraphina, she was convinced that I was strong enough to help her beat the monsters in the cave.
troubling_times.190: Seraphina gave me back the money she had stolen from me earlier.
troubling_times.192: I have to ask Umar for Luthor's key.
troubling_times.195: Seraphina agreed to help me and told me to meet her at the locked door in the cave where Crackshot was defeated.
troubling_times.200: I met Seraphina at the cave door where Crackshot was defeated.
troubling_times.210: Seraphina could open the door with Luthor's key wearing also his gloves. She entered the cave behind the door.
troubling_times.230: Seraphina got injured attacking one of the monsters.
troubling_times.240: I have killed the monsters blocking the entrance.
troubling_times.252: I tried to poison Seraphina, but she noticed in time. At least she didn't notice that I did it on purpose.
troubling_times.255: Seraphina already started the search for the ring.
troubling_times.260: I searched the cave for Luthor's ring. I couldn't find it.
troubling_times.270: Sly Seraphina had found the ring. She gave it to me and told me to keep it safe. She disappeared again, probably back to Sutdover bridge. I had to go to Talion.
troubling_times.280: I gave 50000 gold, Villain's ring, Troublemaker's ring, ring of backstabbing, Tears of the Shadow potion, and Luthor's ring to Talion.
troubling_times.290: Talion used them to undo the spell.
troubling_times.300: Talion returned Luthor's ring. The other rings were broken in the process though and the Tears of the Shadow potion was used up of course.
troubling_times.302: The room with the dangerous creatures has been locked and sealed again.
troubling_times.310: Nanath gave me 75000 gold as a reward for a job well done.
troubling_times.320: Sly Seraphina was friendly to me - for now.

darkprotector.10: I have found a strange looking helmet from the lich 'Toszylae' that I defeated. I should go ask Ulirfendor if he knows anything about it.
darkprotector.15: Ulirfendor in the same dungeon thinks this artifact is what the shrine speaks of, and that it will bring misery to the surroundings of whoever carries it. He wants me to help him destroy it immediately.
darkprotector.26: To destroy the artifact, I would need give the helmet and the heart of the lich to Ulirfendor.
darkprotector.30: I have given the helmet to Ulirfendor.
darkprotector.31: I have given the heart of the lich to Ulirfendor.
darkprotector.35: Ulirfendor has destroyed the artifact. The people of the surrounding towns are safe from whatever misery the helmet would have brought.
darkprotector.40: For helping with both the lich and the helmet, Ulirfendor has given me the dark blessing of the Shadow.
darkprotector.41: For helping with both the lich and the helmet, Ulirfendor wanted to give me the dark blessing of the Shadow, but I declined.
darkprotector.50: I have decided to keep the helmet for myself. Who knows what power I could gain from it.
darkprotector.51: Ulirfendor attacked me for keeping the helmet.
darkprotector.55: I found a book by the shrine where Ulirfendor was. The book talks of a ritual that would restore the helmet to its true power. I should complete the ritual by the shrine if I want to use the helmet.
darkprotector.60: I have started the Kazaul ritual.
darkprotector.65: I have placed the helmet in front of the Kazaul shrine.
darkprotector.66: I have placed the lich's heart in front of the Kazaul shrine.
darkprotector.70: The ritual is complete, and I have restored the power of the helmet to its former glory.

loneford.10: I heard a story about Loneford. Apparently, a lot of people have become ill there recently, and some have even died. The cause is still unknown.
loneford.11: I should investigate what could have caused the people of Loneford to become ill. To gather clues, I should ask the citizens of Loneford and the surrounding areas about what they think is the cause.
loneford.21: The guards in the Crossroads guardhouse are certain that the illness in Loneford is caused by some sabotage done by the priests or people from Nor City.
loneford.22: Some villagers in Loneford believe that the illness is caused by the guards from Feygard, in some scheme to make the people suffer even more than they already have.
loneford.23: Talion, the chapel priest in Loneford, thinks that the illness is the work of the Shadow, as punishment for Loneford's lack of devotion to the Shadow.
loneford.24: Taevinn in Loneford is certain that Sienn in the southeast barn has something to do with the illness. Apparently, Sienn keeps a pet around that has approached Taevinn in a threatening manner several times.
loneford.25: I should go see Landa in the Loneford tavern. Rumor has it that he saw something that he doesn't dare tell anyone.
loneford.30: Landa confused me with someone else at first. He apparently saw a boy doing something around the town well during the night before the illness started. He was scared to talk to me at first since he thought I looked like the boy he had seen. Could it have been Andor that he saw?
loneford.31: Also, the night after he saw the boy at the well, he saw Buceth taking samples of the water in the well. Strangely enough, Buceth has not gotten ill like the others in the village.
loneford.35: I should go question Buceth at the Loneford chapel about what he was doing at the well, and about whether he knows anything about Andor.
loneford.41: I have bribed Buceth into talking to me.
loneford.42: I have told Buceth that I am ready to follow the Shadow.
loneford.45: Buceth tells me that he is assigned by the priests in Nor City to make sure the Shadow casts its glow over Loneford. Apparently, the priests had sent a boy to do some business in Loneford, and Buceth was tasked with gathering some samples from the water well.
loneford.50: I have attacked Buceth. I should bring any evidence that Buceth has on him to Kuldan, the guard captain in the longhouse in Loneford.
loneford.54: I have given the vial that Buceth had on him to Kuldan, the guard captain in Loneford.
loneford.55: Kuldan thanked me for solving the mystery of the illness in Loneford. They will start bringing in water with help from Feygard instead of drinking from the well from now on. Kuldan also told me to visit the castle steward in Feygard if I want to help further.
loneford.60: I have promised to keep Buceth's story a secret. If Andor was indeed here, he must have had a good reason for doing what he did. Buceth also told me to visit the chapel custodian in Nor City if I want to learn more about the Shadow.

shadows.10: I met Borvis on the great road near Alynndir's hut.
shadows.20: Since I had told Gandoren about the switch of the weapons, and also the truth about the bootlegging of beer from Sullengard, he told me to leave.
shadows.30: Since I aided the Shadow once or twice earlier, he requested my further help for an urgent task.
shadows.40: He wanted me to investigate something bad in the Purple Hills in the weird areas to the south of Stoutford.
shadows.50: I went to the area to the south of Stoutford, and encountered an impassable force there.
shadows.60: There were strange glowing, immovable pebbles there. I had to inform Borvis.
shadows.70: Borvis told me that was the basic, but effective, Shadow shield, to protect Shadow incantations from outside interference.
shadows.80: For that, he would give me a chant. But I had to get him energies in the form of four 'blessings' - Shadow's Strength, Shadow Awareness, Fatigue, and Life Drain - within myself. He told me to go to Talion in Loneford for the first blessing, and for information about the others.
shadows.90: Talion bestowed me with Shadow's Strength.
shadows.100: Talion told me to seek out Jolnor in Vilegard for the rest of the 'blessings'.
shadows.110: Jolnor bestowed me with Shadow Awareness.
shadows.120: Jolnor told me to seek Favlon to the west of Sullengard for the remaining two.
shadows.130: I reached Favlon who asked me for 10 Cooked Meat.
shadows.140: I gave Favlon 10 Cooked Meat. He bestowed me with 'blessings' of Fatigue and Life Drain.
shadows.150: After a grueling travel back, I returned to Borvis.
shadows.160: Borvis removed the 'blessings' from me, and made a chant.
shadows.165: Borvis told me to hurry back to the barrier.
shadows.178: After destroying the ritual statue of Kazaul, beyond the barrier I found a crying woman.
shadows.180: She was performing a ritual that should bring her husband back to life.
shadows.190: Borvis, who followed me, convinced the woman that it was actually an evil ritual to overrun Dhayar with Kazaul's monsters.
shadows.200: The mourning woman told us that the ritual was given to her by a priest in the lava wastelands.
shadows.210: We let the mourning woman go.
shadows.212: The mourning woman cried that she would never be happy again.
shadows.220: I had to travel to the lava wastelands.
shadows.230: There, after fighting monsters, I met a priest in red.
shadows.240: He accused me of interfering again and again. Borvis, who again followed me, revealed the red priest to be a monster.
shadows.260: Borvis fulfilled his promise and told me that Andor would be refilling his supplies from Alynndir.
shadows.290: He told me he couldn't come home now, and vanished.
